author: reeseliao
title: ONNX Models Tests job fails with getaddrinfo EAI_AGAIN during artifact upload after all tests passed
signature: getaddrinfo EAI_AGAIN <HOST> during GitHub Actions artifact upload|Network

failed_jobs.name: ONNX Models Tests / ONNX Models tests
failed_jobs.symptom: All 505 ONNX zoo tests passed (2 skipped, 21 xfailed), but the job was marked failed because uploading onnx_models_tests_logs failed with DNS resolution errors (EAI_AGAIN) against GitHub Actions results/blob-storage endpoints.

key_errors: Attempt 1 of 5 failed with error: getaddrinfo EAI_AGAIN results-receiver.actions.githubusercontent.com. Retrying request in 3000 ms...
root_cause: The ONNX Models Tests test suite itself completed successfully with zero failures. The job was marked as failed purely because the post-test artifact-upload step (ababushk/upload-artifact uploading onnx_models_tests_logs) could not resolve DNS for GitHub Actions' internal results-receiver and blob-storage hostnames (results-receiver.actions.githubusercontent.com and productionresultssa9.blob.core.windows.net), producing getaddrinfo EAI_AGAIN errors. This is a transient runner/network DNS resolution problem in the self-hosted runner environment, unrelated to the PR's code changes (PyTorch frontend support for aten::_fake_quantize_learnable_per_channel_affine).
reproduction_steps: N/A - not reproducible locally; this is an infrastructure-side DNS/network failure specific to the GitHub Actions self-hosted runner environment during artifact upload.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed ONNX Models Tests job; the underlying test suite already passed, so a rerun should succeed once DNS resolution recovers.
Investigate the self-hosted runner's DNS resolver/network configuration for intermittent failures resolving *.actions.githubusercontent.com and *.blob.core.windows.net.

Consider adding retry/backoff or marking the artifact-upload step as continue-on-error with if-no-files-found: ignore (already partially configured) so transient upload failures do not fail jobs whose actual tests passed.
Monitor whether this correlates with runner pool/network maintenance windows.
prevention_strategies: Harden CI runner networking (DNS caching/retry) for the hosted test-log artifact uploads, and consider separating the artifact-upload step's exit status from the overall job conclusion when the test step itself succeeded, so transient network blips during post-test uploads don't mask a fully green test run.
historical_context: A similar but distinct Network-category pattern was previously recorded (pattern 4e9cf236bf92d555: 'Upload Test Results fails with ENOTFOUND artifact upload error on Windows runner', count=1, 2026-09-23). That occurrence used ENOTFOUND on Windows; this occurrence uses EAI_AGAIN on a Linux runner against different hostnames, so it is tracked as a new, separate recurring pattern (d877f2bb57b833d0) to keep job-agnostic but still distinguishable network-upload failure signatures separate by concrete DNS error code/behavior.
